spec.description: Operational dashboard for Superbank ingest progress, ClickHouse writes, source health, optional Fumarole backpressure, and optional ClickHouse server metrics.

spec.expr: max by (source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})

spec.description: Selected ingest source types.
spec.title: Ingest sources

spec.expr: max((superbank_ingest_last_processed_slot{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

max((superbank_ingest_last_inserted_slot{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Highest processed and durably inserted slots across the selected ingestors.
spec.title: Current slot positions

spec.expr: max((superbank_ingest_slot_lag{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Largest selected-instance gap between the highest processed and durably inserted slot.
spec.title: Slot lag

spec.expr: max((superbank_ingest_chain_tip_lag{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source=~"fumarole|grpc"}))

spec.description: Largest selected-instance gap between the network tip and durable insertion. This metric is populated only by Fumarole and gRPC sources.
spec.title: Tip lag

spec.expr: sum((rate(superbank_ingest_inserted_slots_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Current durable block-slot insertion rate across selected instances.
spec.title: Slots / second

spec.expr: sum((rate(superbank_ingest_inserted_transactions_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Current durable transaction-row insertion rate across selected instances.
spec.title: Transactions / second

spec.expr: max(clamp_min(time() - ((superbank_ingest_last_successful_flush_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} > 0) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})), 0))

spec.description: Seconds since the most recent successful ClickHouse flush. No value is shown before the first successful flush. This is informational because HEALTH_STALE_SECS is operator-configurable.
spec.title: Last-flush age

spec.expr: sum((rate(superbank_process_cpu_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: CPU seconds consumed per second across selected ingestor processes.
spec.title: Process CPU

spec.expr: sum((superbank_process_resident_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Combined resident memory for selected ingestor processes.
spec.title: Process RSS

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_last_processed_slot{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_last_inserted_slot{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Source processing progress compared with the highest slot durably inserted into ClickHouse.
spec.title: Processed versus inserted slots by instance

spec.expr: sum by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((rate(superbank_ingest_inserted_slots_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Durably inserted block slots per second by ingestor instance.
spec.title: Inserted slot throughput by instance

spec.expr: sum by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((rate(superbank_ingest_inserted_transactions_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Durably inserted transaction rows per second by ingestor instance.
spec.title: Inserted transaction throughput by instance

spec.expr: sum by (table) ((rate(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_rows_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Successful ClickHouse flush throughput grouped by target table.
spec.title: Rows flushed by table

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, table) ((rate(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, table) ((rate(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, table) ((rate(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})))

spec.description: ClickHouse flush latency percentiles for each selected target table.
spec.title: Flush latency percentiles by table

spec.expr: sum by (le) ((increase(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Distribution of ClickHouse flush latency across selected tables.
spec.title: Flush latency heatmap

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) (clamp_min(time() - ((superbank_ingest_last_successful_flush_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} > 0) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})), 0))

spec.description: Current age of each instance's latest successful ClickHouse flush. Missing instances have not flushed successfully yet.
spec.title: Flush age by instance

spec.expr: sum by (table, stage) ((rate(superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_failures_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})) or on (table) ((label_replace(0 * sum by (table) (((superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_rows_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"} >= bool 0) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))), "stage", "none", "", ".*")) unless on (table) ((superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_failures_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})))

spec.description: ClickHouse flush failure rate grouped by target table and failure stage.
spec.title: Flush failures by table and stage

spec.expr: sum by (source, stage, kind) ((rate(superbank_ingest_source_errors_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})) or on (source) ((label_replace(label_replace(max by (source) (0 * (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})), "stage", "none", "", ".*"), "kind", "none", "", ".*")) unless on (source) ((superbank_ingest_source_errors_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"})))

spec.description: Source-side ingest error rate grouped by source, stage, and error kind.
spec.title: Source errors by stage and kind

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_slot_lag{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Processed-to-inserted slot lag by source and instance.
spec.title: Slot lag trend by instance

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_chain_tip_lag{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source=~"fumarole|grpc"}))

spec.description: Network-tip-to-inserted slot lag by source and instance. This metric is populated only by Fumarole and gRPC sources.
spec.title: Chain-tip lag trend by instance

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_buffered_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_memory_soft_limit_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_rss_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_process_resident_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

spec.description: Assembler buffered bytes, configured memory soft limit, pressure-guard RSS sample, and process RSS. This tab has data only for Fumarole instances.
spec.title: Fumarole memory pressure

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_pending_slots{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

spec.description: Slots currently pending in each Fumarole block assembler.
spec.title: Pending slots

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_data_channel_capacity{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

spec.description: Configured Fumarole stream output channel capacity by instance.
spec.title: Data channel capacity

spec.expr: sum by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((rate(superbank_ingest_fumarole_pressure_flushes_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))

spec.description: ClickHouse flushes per second triggered by the Fumarole memory pressure guard.
spec.title: Pressure-triggered flushes

spec.expr: max by (cluster, job, instance, source) (max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_buffered_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))) / on (cluster, job, instance, source) max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_memory_soft_limit_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))) > 0)

max by (cluster, job, instance, source) (max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_rss_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))) / on (cluster, job, instance, source) max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((max by (cluster, job, instance, source) ((superbank_ingest_fumarole_memory_soft_limit_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source", source="fumarole"}))) > 0)

spec.description: Buffered assembler bytes and sampled RSS as a fraction of the configured soft limit. Hidden when the limit is disabled.
spec.title: Memory pressure utilization

spec.expr: max by (table) ((superbank_ingest_clickhouse_flush_rows_total_total{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", table=~"$table"} >= bool 0) * on (cluster, job, instance) group_left(source) (superbank_ingest_source_info{cluster=~"$cluster", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}))

spec.description: Tables observed after at least one successful ClickHouse flush.
spec.title: ClickHouse tables

spec.expr: sum(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalRowsOfMergeTreeTables{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: Change in the selected ClickHouse nodes' aggregate MergeTree row count over the dashboard range. Informational: merges, deletes, and replicated copies also affect this value.
spec.title: Row change over range

spec.expr: sum(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalRowsOfMergeTreeTables{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: Current aggregate MergeTree row count reported by the selected ClickHouse nodes. Replicated rows are counted once per selected replica.
spec.title: Total MergeTree rows

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) (rate(ClickHouseProfileEvents_InsertedRows{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: ClickHouse ProfileEvents inserted-row rate by datacenter and node.
spec.title: Inserted rows / second by node

spec.expr: max by (dc, nodename) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_MemoryResident{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: ClickHouse resident memory reported by each selected server.
spec.title: Resident memory by node

spec.expr: min by (dc, nodename, disk_name) (label_replace({__name__=~"ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_.+", dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}, "disk_name", "$1", "__name__", "ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_DiskAvailable_(.*)"))

spec.description: Available bytes for every disk reported by the selected ClickHouse servers. No fixed threshold is applied because disk capacities and operator policies vary.
spec.title: Available disk space

spec.expr: max by (dc, nodename) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_MaxPartCountForPartition{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: Largest active part count in any partition on each selected node. Sustained growth can indicate merge pressure; thresholds depend on ClickHouse settings.
spec.title: Max parts per partition

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) (deriv(ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalPartsOfMergeTreeTables{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 60)

spec.description: Estimated per-minute trend in total MergeTree parts by node. Positive bars show net part creation; negative bars show net consolidation or removal.
spec.title: MergeTree part trend / minute

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) (ClickHouseMetrics_DistributedFilesToInsert{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: Files waiting in ClickHouse Distributed-engine send queues by node.
spec.title: Distributed send queue — files

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) (ClickHouseMetrics_DistributedBytesToInsert{dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"})

spec.description: Bytes waiting in ClickHouse Distributed-engine send queues by node.
spec.title: Distributed send queue — bytes

spec.expr: sum by (error_name) (increase(label_replace({__name__=~"ClickHouseErrorMetric_.+", __name__!="ClickHouseErrorMetric_ALL", dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}, "error_name", "$1", "__name__", "ClickHouseErrorMetric_(.*)")[$__rate_interval:])) > 0

spec.description: Error-counter increases during each Grafana rate interval, grouped by ClickHouse error name. Zero-only types are suppressed.
spec.title: ClickHouse errors by type

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) (increase(label_replace({__name__=~"ClickHouseErrorMetric_.+", __name__!="ClickHouseErrorMetric_ALL", dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}, "error_name", "$1", "__name__", "ClickHouseErrorMetric_(.*)")[$__rate_interval:])) > 0

spec.description: Aggregate ClickHouse error-counter increases during each Grafana rate interval, grouped by node. Zero-only nodes are suppressed.
spec.title: ClickHouse errors by node

spec.expr: sum by (dc, nodename) ({__name__=~"ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkReceiveBytes_.+", dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}) * 8
sum by (dc, nodename) ({__name__=~"ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_NetworkSendBytes_.+", dc=~"$clickhouse_dc", nodename=~"$clickhouse_node"}) * -8

spec.description: Aggregate ClickHouse asynchronous network receive and send rates across all reported interfaces. Egress is mirrored below zero for directionality.
spec.title: Network throughput — all reported interfaces
